About The Role
 In this role, you will deliver production-ready Angular micro-frontends and integrate them into the common MFE shell. You will own components, automated tests, and deployment configurations that run reliably in Kubernetes, and you will document them so that other teams can operate them with confidence. Your work gives product teams a consistent, maintainable frontend foundation.
 Responsibilities
Implement and maintain a custom design system with Angular 21+ and zoneless signals, so that product teams reuse consistent, accessible components
Deliver micro-frontends and integrate them into the common MFE shell, using SystemJS and Micronaut services on Java 25+
Collaborate with platform engineers, QA specialists, and product teams to plan integrations and release them safely
Build and maintain PostgreSQL-based Micronaut services that support the micro-frontend platform
Develop CLI tools in Bash and Node.js 24+ that automate build, packaging, and delivery workflows
Write and maintain component tests with Cypress and integration tests with Playwright, and keep the test artefacts reliable in CI
Package and publish ORAS/OCI artefacts, and serve frontend assets through a custom CDN on Ceph
Set up OpenTelemetry observability for critical systems, and maintain CI/CD workflows with Azure DevOps pipelines and Argo CD, including technical documentation for operation in Kubernetes
 Requirements
Proven expertise building and maintaining custom design systems with Angular 21+ and zoneless signals
Strong hands-on experience with Micro-Frontend architecture using SystemJS and Micronaut services on Java 25+
Demonstrated proficiency developing PostgreSQL-backed services with Micronaut and Java 25+
Practical expertise creating build and delivery automation with Bash and Node.js 24+
Solid experience developing component tests with Cypress and integration tests with Playwright
Hands-on knowledge of serving frontend assets through Ceph-based custom CDN solutions
Advanced experience implementing CRITIS-level observability with OpenTelemetry
Proven capability packaging, publishing, consuming, and processing ORAS/OCI artefacts
Strong delivery experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, Argo CD, and production-grade Kubernetes deployments
